parameters.help_en: The region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID. To specify multiple cluster IDs, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 集群 ID。多个集群 ID 间用英文逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The description of the cluster. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.help_zh: 集群描述，可模糊查询
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en: The database endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 数据库连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: The status of the cluster
parameters.help_zh: 集群状态
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The database type. Valid values:

MySQL

PostgreSQL

Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
数据库类型，取值范围如下：

MySQL

PostgreSQL

Oracle
parameters.name: db_type

parameters.help_en: The query mode. Set the value to \`Simple\`. In this mode, only the basic metadata of the clusters is returned
parameters.help_zh: 列表查询方式。取值为 Simple，表示简略模式，仅返回集群的基本元数据信息
parameters.name: describe_type

parameters.help_en: The database version
parameters.help_zh: 数据库版本
parameters.name: db_version

parameters.help_en: Filters for clusters created in the last N days. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 筛选最近 N 天创建的集群。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: recent_creation_interval

parameters.help_en: Filters for clusters that expire in N days. Valid values: 0 to 15
parameters.help_zh: 筛选 N 天后过期的集群。取值范围：0~15
parameters.name: recent_expiration_interval

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否集群已过期。取值范围如下：

true

false
parameters.name: expired

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 30, 50, and 100.

Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值为 30、50 或 100。

默认值为 30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0 and does not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于 0 且不超过 Integer 数据类型的最大值，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组 ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The value of the tag key
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The key of tag \`n\`. You can filter clusters by specifying up to 20 tags. The \`n\` must be a unique and consecutive integer that starts from 1. \`Tag.n.Key\` corresponds to \`Tag.n.Value\`
fields.help_zh: 标签键，可以根据标签过滤集群列表。最多 20 对标签，各个标签对的数字 n 必须不同，且必须是从 1 开始的连续整数。Tag.n.Key 对应的值为 Tag.n.Value
fields.name: key

parameters.help_en: The list of tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go

Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按量付费

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The node ID. You can specify multiple node IDs. Separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 节点 ID。支持传入多个节点 ID，多个 ID 间用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: db_node_ids

parameters.help_en: The cloud service provider
parameters.help_zh: 云厂商
parameters.name: cloud_provider

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return for the current request. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A token used to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value returned from the previous API call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（token），取值为上一次api调用返回的nexttoken参数值。如果没有下一个查询，请不传
parameters.name: next_token
